name: Billionbrains Garage Ventures Ltd (Groww)
tagline: India's largest digital investment platform by active users, but already a mega-cap with no stated catalyst for 10x
business_overview: Groww is a Bengaluru-based fintech offering stocks, derivatives, bonds, mutual funds, margin trading, and personal loans through a direct-to-customer digital platform. India's largest broking/investment platform by active NSE users as of mid-2025.
fundamentals_narrative: Solid, quality metrics (21% ROE, real double-digit growth, improving debt), but the company is already a Rs 1.24 lakh Cr mega-cap. A 10x from here would put it among India's very largest listed companies within 2-3 years — no catalyst of that magnitude was surfaced in the preliminary search.
